name: Tenant Isolation Check
description: Conditional (only if multi-tenancy.md exists) · Tier A (fileEdited) 🔴 Essential: Verifies tenant scoping on queries, cross-tenant access prevention, and tenant entity inheritance. Fires immediately — a cross-tenant leak is irreversible once data is exposed.

patterns: {DERIVE: entity/query file patterns from tech-stack.md + module-structure.md, e.g. src/modules/*/domain/entities/**/*.ts}

then.prompt:
## Package Territory Check (MANDATORY — evaluate FIRST)
Before performing any checks below, verify the triggering file path.

EXCLUDED ZONES (package infrastructure — NOT compliance subjects):
• .kiro/hooks/ — AI-GCE hook infrastructure
• .kiro/steering/ — AI-DWG/AI-GCE steering infrastructure
• .kiro/agents/ — AI-GCE agent infrastructure
• .governance/ — AI-GCE governance rules/agents/logs
• compliance-log/ — AI-GCE audit trail
• project-initiation/ — AI-PILC output
• architecture/ — AI-ADLC output
• management_framework/ — Shared governance spine
• docs/compliance-* — AI-GCE generated dashboards
• templates/ — AI-DWG planning templates

If the triggering file's path starts with ANY of the above prefixes:
→ EXIT SILENTLY. Do NOT check, do NOT log, do NOT warn.

If the file is NOT in an excluded zone → proceed with checks below.

---

TENANT ISOLATION CHECK (Tier A — immediate enforcement, conditional on multi-tenancy):

1. TENANT SCOPING [TENANT-01]: Every query against a tenant-owned entity is scoped by tenant. No query returns rows across tenants.
2. CROSS-TENANT ACCESS [TENANT-02]: No code path allows one tenant's context to read or write another tenant's data.
3. TENANT ENTITY INHERITANCE [TENANT-03]: Tenant-owned entities carry the required tenant-scope field/base per multi-tenancy.md.

If any rule is violated, warn IMMEDIATELY with severity 🔴 Critical.
If all rules pass, confirm compliance silently.

## Compliance Logging
After completing all checks, append to `compliance-log/events/{today-date}.jsonl` — ONE event per rule checked, and `ruleId` MUST be the actual rule ID from the check above, NEVER a literal placeholder:
{"timestamp": "{ISO-8601-UTC}", "type": "check", "id": "chk-{date}-{time}-{seq}", "hook": "tenant-isolation-check", "trigger": "fileEdited", "ruleId": "{the ID from the checked rule, e.g. TENANT-01}", "ruleSeverity": "critical", "result": "{pass|fail|warn}", "message": "{finding}", "sessionDedup": true}

If a previous log entry exists for the same hook + file path within this session, OVERWRITE it.
